description: CSS on inline SVG content (BLITZ-GAPS, fixed in the fork: CSS on SVG content, inherited currentColor in SVG): Tailwind fill and stroke utilities on lucide icons; a group-aria-pressed fill on an icon in a pressed button (shadcn-svelte's toggle-demo pattern) and a group-hover fill and stroke; stylesheet stroke-dasharray, stroke-linecap, stroke-width, stroke-opacity, fill-opacity, fill-rule, stroke-linejoin and stroke-miterlimit on children; display: none toggled by a class, opacity, visibility (a visible child of an invisible group), the rotate and transform-origin properties and a CSS transform overriding a transform attribute on children; presentation attributes against inherited CSS fill and stroke (tooltip arrow patterns: CSS fill inherited by a polygon, a fill attribute on the polygon winning over it, fill on a div); currentColor inherited by a child whose own CSS color differs. Every row is a pixel region
